title: ShellGames: Speculative LLM-Driven SSH Deception
title_zh: ShellGames：基于推测式 LLM 的 SSH 欺骗系统
abstract_en: Cyber deception and Moving Target Defense are promising strategies that aim to disrupt adversaries by increasing uncertainty. However, sustaining long-lived, credible interactive sessions with adversaries remains an open challenge. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a promising path toward more dynamic deception systems, but suffer from key limitations that fundamentally limit their applicability, including: lack of persistent state, output inconsistencies, hallucinations, latency, and susceptibility to behavioral subversion that may reveal the deception. We propose ShellGames, an SSH shell simulator based on LLM designed to address these limitations. ShellGames combines five complementary techniques: (i) Automatic Chain-of-Thought and few-shot learning to improve correctness; (ii) memory management to maintain system state coherency; (iii) speculative command execution to reduce response latency; (iv) smart routing of complex interactive commands to a sandboxed environment; and (v) subversion detection leveraging the constrained input-output domain of shell environments. To enable systematic evaluation, we introduce a standardized benchmarking protocol and dataset spanning correctness, consistency, state tracking, and robustness tasks. ShellGames achieves $0.898$ command accuracy on correctness ($+5.3pp$ over baselines), $0.918$ sequence-level accuracy on consistency ($+36pp$), $0.98$ state tracking accuracy ($+18.3pp$), and $0.95$ accuracy on robustness ($+37pp$). A user study with $n=20$ participants confirms that ShellGames achieves realism comparable to a real shell under free exploration and outperforms traditional honeypots on perceived command coverage.
abstract_zh: 网络欺骗（Cyber Deception）与移动目标防御（Moving Target Defense）通过增加不确定性来干扰攻击者，但如何维持长期、可信的交互式会话仍是难题。LLM 为动态欺骗系统提供了新路径，但存在缺乏持久状态、输出不一致、幻觉、延迟高，以及易被行为诱导而暴露欺骗等问题。论文提出 ShellGames，一个基于 LLM 的 SSH shell 模拟器，通过五项技术缓解这些限制：自动 Chain-of-Thought 与 few-shot learning 提升命令输出正确性；内存管理保持系统状态一致；推测式命令执行降低响应延迟；将复杂交互命令智能路由到沙箱环境；利用 shell 输入输出域受限的特点进行颠覆检测。作者还提出标准化评测协议与数据集，覆盖正确性、一致性、状态跟踪和鲁棒性任务。实验显示，ShellGames 在正确性上达到 0.898 命令准确率（较基线 +5.3pp），一致性上达到 0.918 序列级准确率（+36pp），状态跟踪达到 0.98（+18.3pp），鲁棒性达到 0.95（+37pp）。一项 n=20 的用户研究表明，ShellGames 在自由探索下具备接近真实 shell 的真实感，并在感知命令覆盖率上优于传统蜜罐。
key_points_zh: 提出 ShellGames：面向网络欺骗的 LLM-based SSH shell simulator，目标是在攻击者交互过程中维持长期、可信、状态一致的 shell 会话。
通过 Automatic Chain-of-Thought、few-shot learning 与 memory management 改善命令输出正确性、一致性和系统状态跟踪，缓解 LLM 幻觉与无持久状态问题。
引入 speculative command execution 降低响应延迟，并将复杂交互式命令智能路由到 sandboxed environment，以提升交互真实感与命令覆盖范围。
设计 subversion detection，利用 shell 环境输入输出空间受限的特点检测诱导、越狱或试图揭露欺骗的行为。
构建标准化 benchmark 与数据集；ShellGames 在正确性、一致性、状态跟踪和鲁棒性指标上均显著优于基线，并在 n=20 用户研究中表现出接近真实 shell 的体验。

llm_assessment.comment: ShellGames combines state, sandbox routing, latency control, and subversion detection in an LLM runtime, though its application is a niche deception setting.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: ShellGames结合状态管理、沙箱路由、延迟控制和颠覆检测，但应用场景主要局限于网络欺骗。
